children: Kelowna, B.C. – TheNewswire - August 31, 2026. Genesis Acquisition Corp. (“Genesis” or the “Company”) (TSXV: REBL.P) announces that it will not be proceeding with its previously announced Qualifying Transaction with Nusa Nickle Corp. as certain conditions of the transaction were not met by the required dates.
Genesis will continue to evaluate and review alternative acquisition opportunities with a view to completing its Qualifying Transaction.
Trading in the Company’s common shares is expected to resume once approved by the TSX Venture Exchange (the “Exchange”).

Genesis is a Capital Pool Company that completed its initial public offering and obtained a listing on the TSX Venture Exchange (the “Exchange”) on or about November 1, 2019 (trading symbol: REBL.P). Genesis does not carry on any active business activity other than reviewing potential transactions that would qualify as the Company’s Qualifying Transaction, as such term is defined under Exchange Policy 2.4.
